thread:
marta: Heads-up — packaging offline bundle variants for Customer-42. Need shrinkwrap decision ASAP. Current build: installer v1.12.0-rc3, images pinned: rwinf/engine@sha256:ab12cd9f... and rwinf/sidecar@sha256:ef34gh77...

deploy-bot: Packaging job started: job_id=98765 artifact=/artifacts/2026-03-18/1.12.0-rc3.tar.gz sha256=ab12cd9f4e...; shrinkwrap mode=delta+full (both generated).

kai: Quick Q — are we doing customer KMS envelope-wrap for these bundles or shipping cleartext cosign signatures? Need to know for transit plan.

samir: My recommendation: always pin to exact digests for offline bundles (no floating tags). For rollback we should keep a signed manifest with stable tag (stable-2026-03-12) as fallback. Also prefer full bundle for first attempt, delta only for followups.

olivia: Change window is Friday 03:00 UTC for Customer-42. Mirror TTL for offline carriers is 72h by default — can we extend to 7d if we expect transport delays?

marta: Yes extendable. Ops, can we enable 7d TTL for this mirror once packaging finishes?

ops-runbook-bot: Checklist: 1) verify cosign signatures present, 2) KMS wrap if required, 3) manifest shrinkwrap file included, 4) checksums in transport manifest, 5) notify customer + SRE, 6) create rollback manifest.

kai: For this customer they requested KMS wrap. So we need envelope encryption: wrap bundle with their KMS public key and include cosign sig on wrapped blob. I'll own KMS handshake.

marta: Pasting shrinkwrap manifest snippet for review:

```
manifest_version: 1
bundle: rwinf-installer
version: 1.12.0-rc3
images:
  - name: rwinf/engine
    digest: sha256:ab12cd9f4e3a...
  - name: rwinf/sidecar
    digest: sha256:ef34gh77b9c...
shrinkwrap: delta: true, full: true
cosign: present: true
envelope: kms_wrapped: required
```

samir: +1 on manifest. Add a "holdback" boolean in the transport manifest so deploy-bot can gate rollout to manual. Also define rollback criteria: any canary node failing KV-cache warmup OR >10% application errors within first 10 minutes -> abort and fallback to stable-2026-03-12.

deploy-bot: Canary run started: target_nodes=8; results incoming...

deploy-bot: Canary results: pass=6 fail=2. Fail reasons: 2 nodes reported kv_cache_mismatch and transient grpc 503 on first attach. pass_rate=75% < required 90%.

samir: 75% fail -> this meets abort threshold per our rollback criteria. Recommend aborting full rollout and republishing stable manifest as fallback.

marta: Agreed. Aborting full rollout. Action items: 1) tag artifacts with holdback-rc3, 2) republish manifest -> stable-2026-03-12 for automatic fallback, 3) upload KMS-wrapped blobs to secure mirror, 4) open support ticket to coordinate manual install window with customer.

deploy-bot: Rollout aborted by operator marta. Updated transport manifest: holdback=true; active_tag=stable-2026-03-12; holdback_tag=holdback-rc3. Notifying SRE and customer contact.

kai: I'll finish the KMS envelope wrapping and upload to customer mirror with 7d TTL. Will also attach cosign bundle signatures (cosign key id: cosign:02a7).

olivia: I'll update release_notes/1.12.0-rc3.md noting the holdback, canary failure summary, and next steps for manual install. Also updating the canary dashboard with node failure reasons.

ops-runbook-bot: Rollback plan created: steps 1-6 (automated) and manual escalation checklist included. Playbook link: https://go.redwood/ops/playbooks/offline-rollout (created).

samir: One more note — log the exact digest we republish under stable tag and snapshot the prior stable for audit. I'll take ownership of the audit entry.

marta: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after KMS wrap completes and SRE has validated KV-cache fix on the two failing nodes. Marking thread resolved for now.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0420-081. Notifying oncall.

olivia: thanks — assigning follow-ups in the release board. :white_check_mark:
